The brand is the face of ourcompany, it shows our personality   what we stand for, what we are passionate about and what our customers can expect from us.The SKF Vertevo brand is inspired by the world of racing, where the company has contributed to automotive innovation for decades. The identity is designed to keep a connection to the long SKF heritage and expertise, while signalling its ambition to help accelerate the future of mobility.Please note that only the brand is being launched, while the company name continues to remain the same. Any further developments will be communicated to stakeholders as and when applicable.Note: The company had already submitted the financial results for the period ended 30-Sep-2026 on 03rd November 2026.
